scope: Existing seven cinema drafts and fourteen actual preview images. Read-only audit; no new film viewing.
outcome: No newly identified factual or image-provenance blocker. The six short profiles remain introductory essays; several need more subject-specific substance before being presented as deep research.

priority_editorial_followups.issue: Biographical substance is thinner than the methodological commentary.
priority_editorial_followups.evidence: Manmohan spends whole paragraphs explaining date categories, catalogue limits and not inventing scenes, but supplies no specific account of a film's characters or central conflict. Sadhu establishes award/training/direction yet never explains the Ankur performance that earned the award or what distinguishes Abhiman.
priority_editorial_followups.action: Replace some process commentary with a sourced short account of one work in each profile. Establish role/character, narrative situation and contemporary assessment from primary credits/programmes or attributed scholarship. Do not invent scene analysis.

priority_editorial_followups.issue: The dedicated article adds little concrete film history beyond the flagship.
priority_editorial_followups.evidence: It gives the play's author, folk-drummer livelihood, language/year and festival caveat; the argument about preservation and livelihoods is repeated at the opening, middle and ending. No original-play edition, film production credits, performers or distribution history is established.
priority_editorial_followups.action: Add one verified production/adaptation paragraph or interview passage, and identify the play edition and original film credits when accessible. Keep exact Gijon year and community terminology open. Avoid presenting this brief as the completed deep-research article promised by its series plan.

priority_editorial_followups.issue: Family-life framing remains generic compared with the concrete restoration narrative.
priority_editorial_followups.evidence: The essay explains that one person's hopes change a household, but names no character or social circumstance beyond extended middle-class family. It also omits the warehouse discovery despite reliable programme evidence already available.
priority_editorial_followups.action: Use a concise, attributed account of the family conflict or restoration discovery to replace the paragraph defending the absence of fresh scene analysis; maintain MoMA/Bologna source budgets.

priority_editorial_followups.issue: A strong credits-based angle lacks the novel/film's social stakes.
priority_editorial_followups.evidence: Saria, Bhagia and Mangaraj are listed without explaining their relationship or why this literary adaptation mattered. The reader learns who made the film but little about the work they made.
priority_editorial_followups.action: Add a sourced, bounded introduction to the novel's central conflict and its adaptation context. Do not imply the displayed scan was the production's actual edition. A verified portrait would strengthen recognition of the subject.

priority_editorial_followups.issue: The Zwigato section provides the strongest concrete story context; Manto is only a festival label.
priority_editorial_followups.action: If expanded, briefly establish Manto's subject and Das's creative role using existing work-record evidence. The current narrower introduction is accurate. Avoid adding a broad career list merely to increase length.

priority_editorial_followups.issue: The flagship remains mainly a festival/parallel-cinema route, with popular cinema and music acknowledged but lightly represented.
priority_editorial_followups.evidence: Uttam Mohanty receives a short career bridge; composers, writers, audiences and commercial cinema are mostly pointers rather than developed episodes.
priority_editorial_followups.action: Retain the stated selection-of-turning-points scope. Future expansion should add a concrete popular-film/music example and exhibition/distribution context, rather than imply this survey is comprehensive.

series_repetition.finding: Repeated research-process language interrupts otherwise readable introductions.
examples: Maya: interpretive starting point rather than freshly watched scenes; records can be followed/named/checked.
Manmohan: separate dates; catalogue limits; no permission to invent scenes; keep dates beside award.
Sadhu: award can and cannot tell us; not complete filmography or fresh scene criticism.
Bhukha and Nandita end with fresh-viewing disclaimers.
series_repetition.action: Keep one short methodology note or common series note, while retaining specific material caveats beside uncertain claims. Replace repetitive body caveats with sourced details. Do not remove the Gijon uncertainty or eligibility/release distinctions.

image_audit.method: Opened actual fourteen image files as a labelled contact sheet for comparative visual inspection; no browser layout review. Images resized for sheet inspection; small Odia glyph accuracy not assessed.

observed.title: Drum and cloth in an empty courtyard; appropriate symbolic labour/absence motif.
observed.documentary: Photograph of seated director; caption correctly identifies 2014 rather than film still.
observed.limit: Illustration does not document a specific bajnia instrument, community or scene.

observed.title: Painted rural landscape inside a dark frame; fits broad rural theme but generic.
observed.documentary: FTII exterior supports training context only.
observed.limit: Neither image depicts Mahapatra or his actual films; this is the weakest subject-specific visual pairing.

observed.title: Empty domestic rooms and doorways; suitable conceptual family motif.
observed.documentary: Nirad Mohapatra portrait; appropriate direct identification via captionmetadata.
observed.limit: Interior is invented, not a scene or filming location.

observed.title: Illustrated gateways, map, suspended pages and director chair; communicates travel/creative routes.
observed.limit: Invented buildings must not be relabelled Baripada/Bhubaneswar landmarks.

observed.title: Projector illuminating a composite landscape; suits overview.
observed.documentary: Same Sabyasachi portrait used in Bhukha.
observed.limit: Repeated portrait weights the overall history toward one director; composite coastline/temple is not geographical evidence.

observed.title: Book, pencil, reel and viewfinder; corrected artwork appropriately connects writing and cinema.
observed.documentary: Full-page Odia novel scan; useful literary context, not a portrait or film still.
observed.limit: Page cannot establish adaptation fidelity or production edition; tiny text not verified from contact sheet.

observed.title: Empty director chair, stage curtain, lamp and architectural silhouettes; theatre/film motif.
observed.documentary: FTII studio interior; suitable institutional context.
observed.limit: Neither shows Meher or Ankur. Generic skyline must remain conceptual, not film set or biography evidence.

image_audit.verdict: All seven hero images are explicitly labelled AI-generated conceptual editorial illustrations in previews. Documentary images are distinct and captions bound their context. No clear misleading visual claim detected. No actual film still is present anywhere; do not describe this as a film-still gallery.
image_audit.followup: For Sadhu and Manmohan especially, seek licensed subject portraits or permitted film imagery. Do not replace contextual assets with unlicensed stills.

remaining_research: Bhukha original play/credits, exact Gijon register, community terminology.
Legal viewing or scene-specific programme evidence for interpretive expansion.
Manmohan original catalogue chronology access and selective film analysis.
Parbati original credits/award recipient verification beyond memorial archive.
Popular-film, music and distribution context for broader history.
approval_boundary: Current drafts remain accurate introductory reading. This audit is not approval of deep-research completeness, browser rendering, image authenticity beyond stated provenance, or film viewing.
